134013.synopsis:
Trapped in a strange space, I finally emerged after a long time. 
And the world I saw after a long time was calling the place I’d been trapped a dungeon. 
I had lived in a dungeon.

137085.synopsis:
Invincible. Delusional. Cultivation driven purely by willpower.
I, Li Tianwei, was born to be the protagonist.
At three years old, I discovered gravity—too bad Newton beat me to it.
In kindergarten, I commanded twelve generals and plotted to unify the Central Plains—but that damned Ying Zheng took my era first. Truly, kings are destined never to meet.
Only after transmigrating to the cultivation world did I realize—
I really am the protagonist, fated to suppress this age and defy eternity itself.
Unfortunately… the tr*sh system that came with me insists I have a false spiritual root.
Hah! As if I’d believe that nonsense.
How could a mere system comprehend my peerless talent?
A protagonist with a false root? Ridiculous.
Have you ever seen a “false root” form a foundation in a hundred days?
“You ask why a Heavenly Spiritual Root has five clashing colors?
Have you never heard of the Five-Colored Heavenly Root?
Look at me now—didn’t I just ascend to immortality?”
And upon reaching the Immortal Realm—
When others dared question him, Li Tianwei simply waved his hand—
The heavens collapsed, the earth inverted, and time itself reversed.
associated_names: Being a Fake Spiritual Root but Becoming a Heavenly Root on the Same Day — Quite Reasonable, Right?
伪灵根当天灵根修成仙，很合理吧

146813.synopsis:
My noble fiancé has become a prisoner.
He was beaten deaf in one ear and left on the street to be sold.
I squatted in front of him and whispered, “If I come to break off the engagement at a time like this, you won’t think I’m kicking you when you’re down, will you?”
Heaven can bear witness!
When I came yesterday, he was still the high and mighty heir apparent!
How did he become a Criminal s*ave overnight?
He opened his eyes and looked at me calmly.
Shouts came from behind: “Are you buying or not? If not, let us have a look!”
All the Madams in the capital are waiting to inspect him.
If you buy him, he’ll be a Money Tree.
“Look at her shabby appearance, she definitely can’t afford it.”
I was furious when I heard that: “Who are you looking down on? I’ll buy him!”

147581.synopsis:
The peak of her life!
Niveia Loren, the shining diamond of high society, was enjoying her golden age.
But the moment she realizes she has reincarnated after a sudden accident… the original story grabs her by the ankle.
“I’m… the villainess?”
In the original plot, she’s the fake daughter who gets abandoned miserably once the real daughter appears.
So she decides to flee the country before the story begins.
But after living a spoiled life as the beloved youngest daughter, she has one big problem—she has no money when she actually needs it.
Thinking fast, she switches to Plan B: find a contract–marriage partner.
So I just went straight in and asked—
“Would you like to try getting married to me?”
I literally started by proposing.
And to make it worse, I proposed to Étienne Ortez, the villain of the original story.
***
The plan is big! The effect will be certain!
A national-level scam that goes from: secret dating → public dating → finally marriage.
“I was thinking… maybe he and I are tied by the red string of fate.”
I even stole the destiny line that a princess from a neighboring country—who’s obsessed with Étienne—loves to say.
And when I fully used the abilities I remembered from the original story, everything I touched started becoming a huge success.
“Remember this, Niveia.”
And this man…
“In situations this unreasonable, your husband is there for you to take advantage of.”
Why… does he seem like he genuinely loves me?

158845.synopsis:
【Global survival | Farming & infrastructure | Power progression | No CP (romance-free)】
Before the global island survival event fully arrived, it briefly appeared as a mobile game for three hours.
In her previous life, Ji Xinghe didn’t notice the new app that appeared on her phone. While taking a cab after work, she was hit by a heavy truck, broke her leg, and gave up on everything.
After entering the game, she found herself struggling on a 4-square-meter island.
Trial worlds, natural disasters, dungeons, sea beasts circling around her—the environment only got harder to survive in.
After barely hanging on for six months, a terrifying tsunami swallowed her whole.
Given a second chance, she’s determined to seize the three-hour head start and spend money to buy the Talent Stone she never got in her previous life.
During the mobile game phase, she exploits infinite-use fishing rods and hauls in treasure chest after treasure chest.
Once the real game begins, while others are still starving and miserable, she already has dozens of treasure chests waiting to be opened.
When the leaderboard goes live, Ji Xinghe sweeps all three charts.
“Survival game?”
“This time, I’ll make the ocean my hunting ground! Survival is my game!”
associated_names: 全民求生：提前三小时登录

169597.synopsis:
Lin Mo transmigrates into a world where everyone undergoes Class Awakening.
He awakens as a Blank Mage with no elemental affinity.
Without any elemental talent, he cannot learn high-tier elemental spells.
Fortunately, his family is extremely wealthy. Lin Mo decides he might as well lie back and live the carefree life of a rich second-generation heir.
But then—
His skills gain consciousness.
[“Fireball” believes it has the potential of a Forbidden Spell and refuses to remain a mere lighter!] 
[To prove itself, it runs away from home and begins slaughtering monsters on its own!] 
[Congratulations! Your “Fireball” has independently evolved and learned ‘Multiple Explosive Fireballs’!] 
[Congratulations! Your “Fireball” has independently evolved and learned ‘Explosive Spiral Dragon Flame’!] 
…
[Congratulations! Your “Fireball” has comprehended the True Essence of Fire and evolved into — World-Ending Crimson Lotus!] 
And that’s not all.
As Lin Mo levels up, every new skill he learns starts behaving strangely as well…
While other mages grind monsters day and night to level up, Lin Mo lounges under a sun umbrella sipping iced juice — while his skills are already going on killing sprees.
Years later—
The Abyss splits open. Trillions of Demon Gods descend, plunging the world into despair.
Lin Mo sighs helplessly:
“Stop fighting over it. Today… I’ll allow you unlimited firepower.”
In the next instant, the heavens lose their color.
Fire, earth, water, lightning, wood, light, darkness, time, space…
Forbidden spells from every element erupt like fireworks.
Trillions of Demon Gods are annihilated beneath the endless radiance of these spells.
A Demon God trembles and roars:
“W-What kind of monster are you?!”
Lin Mo exhales a puff of smoke and shrugs:
“I’ve said it countless times… I’m really just a mage.”
associated_names: 刚转职法师，技能成精了什么鬼？

190589.synopsis:
Xu Man is reborn, returning to the year she first met Jiang Ting.
In her previous life, Jiang Ting played her and betrayed her. This time, she was determined to give him a taste of his own medicine… down to the very last detail.
…
All these years, Jiang Ting has never truly loved anyone. Not until he met Xu Man did he begin to believe in fate.
It turned out that there really could be a woman made exactly to your liking; she had the face you adored, carried the scent you loved, knew which wine you preferred, which dishes you enjoyed, and even down to what kind of position you preferred while kissing.
Jiang Ting believed Xu Man was hopelessly in love with him.
Until the day he picked up her diary.
On the very last page, it read:
“Damn it… when can I finally break up with this idiot?”
Later, a rumor spread through the elite circles of Jincheng: Jiang Ting had been completely played by a woman. She vanished overnight without a trace, and he swore he would find her no matter what.
A scheming green tea/white lotus FL × ML who appears cold and aloof but is actually naive and ridiculously rich.
associated_names: Love dies in the spring breeze
渣了大佬后他更爱我了
